fields.System.Title: RPL-303 — Complete the move
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want confirming the task to move the stock, so that the
pick face shows the stock that is now physically in it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid confirmation, then stock moves from bulk to the pick face, a movement is
  • written, and the task closes — in one transaction.
  • - Given the transaction fails, then nothing changed.
  • - Given the same confirmation sent twice with one idempotency key, then stock moves once.
  • - Given completion, then replenishment.task_completed is published.
  • - Given completion, then the moved stock is immediately available for allocation.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | replen_task, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Partial commit ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate confirm ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · rollback · invariant |
